utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m here for the repair drive—what still needs help?

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Hana — once the time’s set, I’ll let you know right away and we’ll lock in the meeting spot.

utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s a huge help, Sam—thank you! I’ll let everyone know the tools are sorted and the sign-in table’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Tess — just let me know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll send you the list now, and please let everyone know we’re meeting Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll start reaching out and let folks know we’re meeting Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — thank you. I’ll send the list over right away, and I appreciate you helping spread the word for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I jump in—what time is the repair drive, and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — 10 a.m. at the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, 10 a.m. at the community center entrance — I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’ll see you there and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve got the community center by Maple Park noted, and I’ll watch for the exact address.

utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send the exact address as soon as I have it. Please keep spreading the word about the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — we’re gathering screws, a few paint brushes, and heavy-duty tape. If you can, bring any extra supplies and I’ll keep everything sorted here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I can grab a couple extra paint brushes and some tape on my way over. I’m still running a bit late, but I’ll be there soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Dane — thanks for grabbing those. I’ll keep the table organized and we can sort everything as soon as you get here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll just show up and help, and I’ll grab a screwdriver if I can find one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds perfect, Mina — just your helping hands and whatever screwdriver you can find is plenty. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll see you there and bring the screwdriver if I can find it.

utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to add you to the invite list too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—let’s start with the biggest repairs first, and I’ll get the invite list moving too.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll keep things organized and be at the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Uli — I really appreciate it, and I’ll make sure everyone knows where to find you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks — I’m still catching up, so the latest on what you need would really help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just send folks to the repair drive and keep an ear out for any extra tools or parts we can use.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll pass that along and keep an ear out for extra tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the community center by Maple Park is still fine for me. If you can point me to the north entrance, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — use the north entrance on the Maple Park side, just past the main lot. I’ll point you there when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll head to the Maple Park side and look for the north entrance. Thanks, that should be enough for now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — please keep me posted as soon as you confirm the labels and tool list. I’m trying to avoid any last-minute gaps in the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the labels and tool list and keep you posted right away if anything’s missing. I’ll spread the word so folks know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps a lot — please also confirm the drop-off time so we don’t get crossed wires. If anything changes, let me know right away and I’ll adjust the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still a little foggy, but I can check the tools list and confirm the donation drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — could you also make sure the drop-off time is posted clearly so nobody shows up early? I’m trying to keep the schedule from getting messy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll post the drop-off time clearly so nobody comes early. I’ll double-check the tools list too.

utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli—see you at 3:00, and I’ll help set up the tool table when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, 3:00 works for me. I’ll bring my gloves and be there a little early.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect—thanks, Eli. I’ll bring the tool table setup and catch up as soon as I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll bring the sturdy boxes and help sort the donations when I arrive. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a bit fuzzy on the exact address. I should have it soon, but for now the community center by Maple Park works.

utterances.speaker: Mara
